ADUO DEPLOYING THIS ROUND: ADUO upgrade 1 deployed at Zandvoort (R12), 2 allocated (>4% deficit). Updated RA626H targeting raw ICE power, Honda's stated main weakness, plus minor battery changes. Honda has said it will use only ONE of its two 2026 tokens. Effect is unproven — Zandvoort is a sprint weekend, so there is a single practice session to evaluate it. Historical fingerprints predate it, so this prediction understates any gain.
⚠ INCOMING R12: Netherlands R12 — second major chassis package, following the major AMR26 update introduced at Hungary (R11). PU side is covered by the Honda ADUO note; not repeated here.
